addSharedTip: One layer the picked clips share: change it once, they all change
autoTip: White balance and exposure: greys made grey, the middle at a usual level
copyTip: Copy this clip's grade onto other clips
resetTip: Take this clip's grade off (its footage kind stays)
curveHint: Click to add a point, drag to move it, double-click or drag it out to remove it
fileLayer: This layer is a LUT file: its numbers can't be dragged here. Remove it or replace it.
pickMatch: Click a shot: this one is matched to its color
pickCopy: Click shots to copy this grade to them
scopeNote: Measured as exported: the footage at its own depth, through this shot's whole grade.
filterLayer: This layer is a filter: change it or its strength in Styles.
agentNote: The agent in the chat edits these same grade files: what it does shows here at once, and you can keep adjusting.
noFilters: The library has no filters yet.
copiedGrade: Copied the grade of {name}: pick other shots and press ⌘V to paste
pickWhiteTip: Click something that should be white or grey; temperature and tint are worked out
toAgentTip: Put the shots in hand into the chat for the agent to keep grading
startNone: This film has no picture to grade yet
startNoneBody: The color workbench grades the film’s picture: videos, stills and pictures made of web pages. The timeline has none of them yet, only sound.
startNoneStep1: Go back to the edit and drag a video or a still from the library onto the timeline, or ask your agent to make one.
startNoneStep2: Come back to Color: each picture is a shot in the strip; click it to grade it.
startPick: Pick a shot to start grading
startPickBody: The strip holds every picture of the film: videos, stills and pages. You grade one shot at a time, or hold ⇧ to grade several together.
startStep1: Click a shot in the strip; the picture jumps to it. Drag across its picture to move through the shot.
startStep2: In Basic drag the sliders for exposure, contrast and temperature, or in Wheels push the shadows, midtones and highlights toward a color; check the result on the scopes and the picture.
startStep3: When one shot looks right, use Copy to… for the others. Or just tell the chat “make every shot a little warmer” and keep tuning after your agent.

tabTip.basic: Sliders for exposure, contrast, saturation and temperature: the usual place to start
tabTip.wheels: Push the shadows, midtones and highlights toward a color; the line under each wheel makes it brighter or darker
tabTip.curves: By brightness: add points on the curve and drag to lift shadows or hold highlights
tabTip.hue: By color: change the hue, saturation or brightness of one color only, like a bluer sky
tabTip.styles: Apply a look in one click, then set its strength

drawnInTip: A page’s or a still’s picture is what the screen shows already: there is no footage input to pick.
hueDrawn: Hue curves can’t be drawn on a page or a still: not here
exportLutDrawn: A page’s or a still’s grade is drawn by the browser itself, not exported as a LUT
scrubTip: Drag across: move through the shot
